summary_1line: Sanjaya meets Yudhishthira at Upaplavya, exchanges formal inquiries about the Kuru elders, and reports Dhritarashtra’s regret while recalling the Pandavas’ feared prowess.

image_candidates.scene_text: Sanjaya bows before Yudhishthira in the Pandava court at Upaplavya while the five brothers and Draupadi listen.
Yudhishthira seated calmly among his brothers speaks of Arjuna’s thunderous Gandiva arrows and Bhima’s mace striking terror.
Messengers and warriors gather in the Pandava camp as Sanjaya delivers Dhritarashtra’s words of regret and caution.
